description: This PHP script generates a PDF for a purchase order in the vtiger CRM system. It loads a controller, processes a record, retrieves a sequence number, and outputs a downloadable PDF file.

classes.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the PDF generation and output for purchase orders.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for initializing the PDF controller.

methods.name: loadRecord
methods.description: Loads the purchase order record based on the provided ID.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF, either inline or as a download.
